title: Mark the surgical site before the procedure
citation: Joint Commission Hospital NPG.01.06.02 EPs 1–3, effective January 2026, p. 5
entrenchedBecause: Joint Commission hospital accreditation, used for Medicare deemed status; losing accreditation creates participation and contracting risk.
proposedRule: Mark the site before applicable invasive procedures.
needsCoreFeature: Procedure-start event, site-marking applicability and accountable human evidence.
notes: Related to R2-15, but distinct from time-out. Applies at minimum when multiple possible locations create safety risk. Involve patient if possible; accountable licensed practitioner marks, with limited qualified delegation. No blanket requirement for unmarkable sites.

title: Resolve medication reconciliation discrepancies
citation: Joint Commission Hospital NPG.14.05.01 EP 3, effective January 2026, p. 45
entrenchedBecause: Joint Commission hospital accreditation, used for Medicare deemed status; losing accreditation creates participation and contracting risk.
proposedRule: Resolve discrepancies between home medications and hospital orders.
needsCoreFeature: Per-medication reconciliation and discrepancy-resolution completeness.
notes: E8/E16 baseline retained. V1 requires one medRecDecision at signNote and dischargeMedRec at discharge; neither proves complete comparison by a qualified individual. Extra display and commit gates are proposed hospital implementation.

title: Record metric weight
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals 2026–2027, Best Practice 3(a)–(b), p. 5
proposedRule: Record weight only in metric units.
notes: V1 is stricter: kg only, whereas ISMP also permits grams. Existing entry requirement; regulations.md E5. Narrow mapping: the kg unit constraint exists; this does not certify every written format in the hospital.
entrenchedBecause: Near-universal medication-safety standard of care: ISMP documents recurrent fatal dosing errors; preventable medication harm creates malpractice exposure.

title: Measure encounter weight
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals 2026–2027, Best Practice 3(a)–(b), p. 5
proposedRule: Obtain measured weight at admission and appropriate encounters.
needsCoreFeature: Measured-weight provenance and encounter linkage.
notes: Do not delay life-saving treatment to weigh a major-trauma patient; laboratory-only encounters are excluded. V1 has a weight entry, not this provenance/exception check.
entrenchedBecause: Near-universal medication-safety standard of care: ISMP documents recurrent fatal dosing errors; preventable medication harm creates malpractice exposure.
